title: Dick Russell's day-long interview with Sidney Gottlieb

tellings.quote: has one of the only interviews, as far as I know, with Sidney Gottlieb. He spent a whole day with him.

plain: A researcher named Greg Malatzi says that the writer Dick Russell got one of the only interviews ever given by Sidney Gottlieb, a CIA scientist, sometime in the 1990s at Gottlieb's house. Malatzi says Russell spent a whole day with him. If true, it would make Russell's interview a rare first-hand window into a man who knew a great deal about the agency's secret research.
